description: This file defines a 'NotesList' component for a Lightning.js application, managing a list of notes, including creation, selection, and UI rendering.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A Lightning.js component that displays and manages a list of notes, handling note creation and selection.

methods.name: _syncFromStore
methods.description: Synchronizes the component state with the app's store, updating notes, selected note, and focused index.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new empty note via the store.

methods.name: _moveSelection
methods.description: Moves the current selection up or down in the notes list based on delta.
